results.title: Vadam
results.overview: A action packed Village Family Drama. Hero’s Extraordinary Bond with his Bull. Story based on “Vada Manju Virattu”.  Family relationship highlighted emotionally

results.title: Sketches on Ice
results.overview: Lou and Marius are having fun in the street building a snowman. But Mom calls them home—Marius has to practice his clarinet, and Lou has to do her homework.

results.title: When It Goes Dark
results.overview: The only thing separating Nina and Richard from divorce is a contract they once wrote on a paper napkin while drunk, in which they pledged that whoever causes the end of the relationship will not receive a single crown from their joint property.

results.title: Stardom in Okayama 2026 Feb.
results.overview: Stardom in Okayama 2026 Feb. was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on February 23, 2026 at Okayama Convention Center in Okayama, Japan.

results.title: Aldeas: A New Story
results.overview: A documentary built around Pope Francis’s final in-depth interviews, following Scholas Occurrentes’ cinema initiative as it brings together education, filmmaking, and community building.

results.title: Mozart: The Magic Flute @  Aix-en-Provence Festival 2026
results.original_title: Mozart : La flûte enchantée Festival d'Aix-en-Provence 2026
results.overview: For years, *The Magic Flute* has been one of the most frequently performed operas at the Aix-en-Provence Festival. After an eight-year absence, Mozart’s work is now back on the programme. Clément Cogitore interprets the plot as a modern coming-of-age story: Tamino and Pamina leave the world of childhood behind and enter a reality in which beauty is fragile and truth is uncertain.

results.title: Spirit Guardians: The Last Secret of the First Emperor
results.original_title: Hộ Linh Tráng Sĩ: Bí ẩn mộ Vua Đinh
results.overview: Set in the Dinh Dynasty of the 10th century, the period film follows seven loyal warriors who must race against time to transport 99 coffins to different parts of the kingdom as a decoy to the enemy and keep the final resting place of the first emperor a secret.

results.title: Railfan
results.overview: A curious, heartwarming documentary following a photographer as he makes a portrait series of autistic kids who love New York City subways. While overlooked by many, subways retain a magic in their ability to transport us to the destinations of our choosing. For autistic children, they can mean so much more. Following a group of these unique kids in New York City, Railfan explores the deep fascinations that autistic people have (a.k.a. “special interests”) through gentle observation, and invites you into a secret world where imagination and urban geographies overlap.

results.title: Cassandre - Les inconnus du Sapenay
results.overview: Spring reveals the secrets buried under the Sapenay pass, overlooking Lake Annecy. As the snow melts, a hiker discovers in a cave the body of a woman, killed by a bullet through the heart. Near this still anonymous victim, two other bodies, men, lie under the snow, frozen for years.

results.title: Mozart: Piano Concerto No. 21 - Mao Fujita in Valencia
results.original_title: Mozart : Concerto pour piano n° 21 Mao Fujita à Valence
results.overview: The piano concerto no. 21 in C major by Mozart is performed by the Valencia Orchestra with Japanese pianist Mao Fujita as soloist. The setting: The historic courtyard of the Old University. Part of europiano, ARTE's special day celebrating the piano concerto across Europe.

results.title: Murabi
results.overview: In every family, there is a guiding force, the Murabi. This Odia feature film explores the collision and convergence of two contrasting philosophies: one rooted in discipline and control, the other in joy and freedom. As life brings these worlds together, the story unfolds into a heartwarming journey that challenges, inspires, and ultimately redefines the true meaning of family, love, and togetherness.

results.title: Цепенеющий лох
results.overview: At a provincial film festival, a young director who unexpectedly wins the top prize spends one absurd night with his friends. While everyone around him is discussing the award, drinking, falling in love, arguing about the coolness of the Husky, waking up the plane, the main character gradually understands that the real value of this night is not the victory or the movie, but random intimacy with a person.

results.title: Ana, en passant
results.overview: After her grandmother’s death, Ana finds herself adrift. Following the clues left by her late grandmother, Ana arrives in Belo Horizonte and meets Alice. As they make sense of the city’s layout and their memories, Ana and Alice will discover what it means to become who they are.

results.title: A Shadow in the Corner of the Room
results.original_title: A Shadow in the Corner of the Room
results.overview: Down-on-her-luck nurse, Avery, dismisses a care home resident's warnings of a shadowy presence as dementia...until it begins to turn its attention to her.

results.title: Tropical SOV: Bizarre Sci-fi Samba
results.overview: Once again, 23 Brazilian filmmakers come together for the second Tropical SOV anthology, now exploring sci-fi in humorous stories involving aliens and their space invasions, mad scientists, time travel, dystopias, and a myriad of end-of-the-world scenarios.

results.title: Obex
results.overview: Conor Marsh lives a secluded life with his dog, Sandy, until one day he begins playing OBEX, a new, state-of-the-art computer game. When Sandy goes missing, the line between reality and game blurs and Conor must venture into the strange world of OBEX to bring her home.

results.title: The Cycle of Love
results.overview: Explores the romantic journey of PK Mahanandia, a Delhi street artist who trekked 6,000 miles by bicycle in 1977, venturing across continents to reunite with the woman he loved.

results.title: TANK
results.overview: Lis, a 21-year-old woman, wanders through the streets of Rio de Janeiro carrying the absence of someone who is no longer there. Between memories, unexpected encounters, and events that blur the line between reality and imagination, she moves through the city searching for a way to cope with what remains.
